description: Source code for a Kotlin Android activity named HomeActivity, which serves as the main screen for a TV app. It manages a top menu and horizontally scrollable content rails loaded from an API, with custom D-pad navigation logic.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the TV home screen, managing UI setup, content rails, and focus navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity UI, top menu, content rails, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation menu with focus and click behavior.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Builds the horizontal content rails, handles data binding, image loading, and custom focus navigation logic.

methods.name: handleSecondRowDpadUp
methods.description: Custom logic to remap DPAD_UP from the second row to the aligned item in the first row for better focus navigation.
